title: lobelia zeylanica var. hirta
intro: Lobelia zeylanica var. hirta, commonly known as Indian tobacco, is a plant species native to India and other parts of Asia. It is used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of Indian tobacco include its ability to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and reduce stress. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids like lobeline, which have been shown to have expectorant and bronchodilator properties.
